top_paper.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
top_paper.summary: Benchmark Radar is a searchable living database and discovery engine for AI evaluation benchmarks that aggregates sources, score histories, and evidence to support benchmark selection and comparison.

papers.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
papers.summary: PhysBrain 1.5 unifies physical environment understanding, action generation, and future state prediction via joint autoregressive training on discrete vision-language, motion, and visual target sequences, achieving state-of-the-art open-source embodied performance.

papers.title: Not All Prompts Are Equal: Exploration-Guided Prompt Scaffolding for Multimodal Reinforcement Post-Training
papers.summary: The framework dynamically adjusts training prompts via exploration potential scoring and scaffolded rewrites to improve reinforcement learning for multimodal language models.

papers.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
papers.summary: Vidu S2 introduces real-time interactive avatar and video editing models that support high-resolution spatial video generation and dynamic reference updates.

papers.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
papers.summary: Discovery Foundation Models enable open-ended scientific discovery through iterative problem formulation, hypothesis testing, and evidence-based revision across dry and wet lab settings.

papers.title: Attention-DP3: Spatially Object-aware 3D Diffusion Policy via Geometry-aligned Attentional Conditioning
papers.summary: Attention-DP3 improves 3D diffusion policies by injecting object-level geometric cues via attention to stabilize performance under heavy clutter.

papers.title: BVB: Benchmarking Agentic Video Understanding via Programmatic Reconstruction in Blender
papers.summary: A benchmark requiring agents to programmatically reconstruct real-world videos in Blender reveals that current models achieve high perceptual similarity but struggle to retain spatiotemporal facts.

papers.title: LLaDA-UI: Bringing Block-wise Diffusion to Vision-Language GUI Agents
papers.summary: A 16.7B-parameter mixture-of-experts diffusion vision-language agent achieves strong multimodal GUI performance while preserving block-parallel decoding efficiency.

papers.title: Dream-RSI: Recursive Self-Improvement through Evolving Worlds
papers.summary: Dream-RSI enables scalable recursive self-improvement by using historical discovery replay to evaluate exploration policies offline, reducing costly online evaluations.

papers.title: Omni-Streaming Thinking
papers.summary: Omni-Streaming Thinking improves streaming omni-modal reasoning by deferring claims until cross-modal verification, reducing premature commitment and auditory hallucinations.

papers.title: ReMoMask-2: Latent Retrieval-Augmented Masked Motion Generation
papers.summary: ReMoMask improves text-to-motion generation via hierarchical contrastive retrieval and topology-aware fusion, while ReMoMask-2 eliminates representation gaps by embedding retrieval directly into the generator's latent space.

papers.title: MobileVLA-R1 2.0: RL-Enhanced Reasoning for Mobile Robot Control
papers.summary: MobileVLA-R1 2.0 couples structured reasoning with robot control via chain-of-thought alignment and reinforcement learning to improve long-horizon mobile robot instruction following.

papers.title: Occamy-1.0: Open Pareto-frontier 35B Intelligence for Co-work
papers.summary: Occamy-1.0 is a cost-efficient co-work agent model that achieves strong performance on complex multi-step tasks while maintaining broad agentic capabilities at lower cost.

papers.title: Pelican-Sim 1.0: A General World Model Simulator for Embodied Intelligence
papers.summary: Pelican-Sim 1.0 is a general world model simulator for embodied intelligence that predicts future observations from visual context and robot actions, using unified action representations, action-visual injection, sparse mixture-of-experts, and efficient rollout generation to improve controllability and video quality across diverse embodiments and tasks.

papers.title: ReactHuman: A Physics-Grounded Benchmark for Human-Like Reactive Decision-Making in Embodied Multimodal LLMs
papers.summary: ReactHuman is a physics-grounded benchmark that evaluates multimodal large language models as decision cores for simulated humanoid robots facing sudden household hazards, revealing persistent reactive safety failures.

papers.title: Competence-Gated Pooling of Language Models and Priors for Event Forecasting
papers.summary: A competence gate selectively integrates language model forecasts by estimating domain-level marginal value over external predictions, improving hybrid forecasting accuracy.

papers.title: Feature Recovery for Object Understanding After Irreversible Fire Damage
papers.summary: TRACE is a benchmark for post-fire object understanding that introduces a feature recovery module to restore degraded representations and improve detection and vision-language tasks under severe physical damage.

papers.title: Towards a Deterministic Math Solver for Clinical Language Models
papers.summary: A program-solve interface that delegates arithmetic to a restricted Python executor improves clinical calculator accuracy for larger open-weight language models but not consistently for smaller ones, and it does not replace verified formulas or reliable variable extraction.

papers.title: Ambient @ EgoProactive 2026 : Proactive Egocentric Assistance with Visually Grounded Supervision
papers.summary: The approach reformulates intervention timing as single-token classification and uses a video agent for visual supervision to improve wearable assistant decision-making.

papers.title: Ambient @ EgoLongQA 2026: Distilling Long-Video perception into a Sub-2B Model
papers.summary: A 2B vision-language model distilled from a tool-using agent achieves first-place performance on long egocentric video question answering by pruning its multilingual embedding table to meet parameter limits.

papers.title: Studying Without a Syllabus: Task-Agnostic Environment Preprocessing
papers.summary: An agent can explore unfamiliar environments without task-specific guidance to build reusable artifacts that reduce later inference costs, though larger study budgets do not always improve results.

papers.title: TRACE: Trajectory-robust Admission with Evidence Ordering for Efficient GUI Agents
papers.summary: TRACE is a training-free framework that ranks visual evidence by future utility and diversity, reserves native tokens for spatial coverage, and contracts retired frames to reduce latency and memory in GUI agents.

papers.title: ActionSplice: In-Flight Action Editing for Interactive World Models
papers.summary: ActionSplice introduces counterfactual state transport to splice revised actions into chunk-autoregressive video world models without replaying completed evaluations, improving fidelity and speed.

papers.title: DataFlex-RL: An Evaluation Platform for RLVR Data Policies
papers.summary: DataFlex-RL evaluates reinforcement learning data policies and finds that uniform sampling matches or exceeds adaptive rollout selection, reweighting, and domain mixing across math, logic, and science benchmarks.

papers.title: Building and Evaluating Fixed-Voice Thai TTS from Synthetic Speech
papers.summary: A compact Thai text-to-speech model is distilled from a large voice-cloning teacher using synthetic data from brief voice references, achieving strong on-device accuracy and prosody with minimal errors.

papers.title: How Far Can Synthetic Data Take Thai OCR?
papers.summary: A Thai OCR model trained solely on synthetic documents achieves strong real-world performance by isolating key transfer factors like typography, layout, and handwriting glyphs.

papers.title: Beyond Top-k Skill Retrieval: Diversity-Aware Skill Routing for LLM Agents
papers.summary: Diverse Skill Routing improves LLM agent skill selection by balancing relevance with non-redundancy via a determinantal point process, boosting multi-skill coverage.

papers.title: Online Learning with LLM Experts from Limited Feedback
papers.summary: Adaptive routing of prompts to LLM experts is formulated as a contextual bandit problem with limited feedback, yielding algorithms with sublinear regret bounds and effective routing strategies.

papers.title: StepAudio 3 Gen Technical Report
papers.summary: StepAudio 3 Gen is a discrete autoregressive audio generation model that uses residual vector quantization tokens and a shared code space to unify text-to-speech, voice design, sound effects, and music within a single framework.

papers.title: Feyospace-v1: How the Cyber Mercury Seven Trained Frontier Cyber Models
papers.summary: A data-centric framework with specialized systems for reasoning analysis, cost reduction, and execution verification enables small teams to train open-weight cyber agents that achieve top-tier performance on benchmark suites.

papers.title: Benchmark Radar: A Living Database and Search Engine for AI Benchmarks and Evaluation
papers.summary: Benchmark Radar is a searchable living database and discovery engine for AI evaluation benchmarks that aggregates sources, score histories, and evidence to support benchmark selection and comparison.
